summary: Email notification with IPS QR code feature fully tested. All 14 backend tests passed. Frontend booking flow with email field works end-to-end. IPS QR code displays correctly on confirmation page. Background email task runs gracefully without SMTP credentials (logs warning, doesn't crash). Reservation creation succeeds even without email sending.

Backend: clean_bank_account formats to 18 chars with padding
Backend: generate_ips_qr_string produces NBS-compliant format with \n delimiters
Backend: generate_ips_qr_image returns valid PNG bytes (magic bytes verified)
Backend: _get_smtp_config returns config dict with defaults
Backend: _build_html generates valid HTML with CID image reference (cid:qrcode_image)
Backend: send_booking_confirmation_email handles missing SMTP gracefully (no crash)

Backend: Reservation created with all fields including client_email (stored lowercase)

Backend: Background email task logs 'SMTP credentials not configured' warning
Frontend: Email input field visible with data-testid='client-email-input'

Frontend: Full booking flow with email works end-to-end
Frontend: IPS QR code visible on confirmation page with data-testid='ips-qr-code'

routes.py line 491-506: Background task properly added with BackgroundTasks.add_task()

IPS QR code is NBS-compliant with proper Serbian transliteration. Frontend shows QR code on confirmation page with bank account details.
